mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_number, p.amount AS paid_amount, p.refunded_amount, p.currency, p.paid_at, r.refund_number, r.order_id AS refund_order_id, r.amount AS refund_amount, r.currency AS refund_currency, r.succeeded_at FROM payment_records p LEFT JOIN refund_records r ON r.payment_id = p.id AND r.status = 'SUCCEEDED' WHERE p.order_id = #{orderId} AND p.status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY p.id, r.succeeded_at, r.id
